content:
anya: heads-up — PR #482 integration-hosted-smoke is red on shard-19, 6 failing tests (4 streaming-toolcall 401s, 2 auth-handshake timeouts). full run: https://ci.redwood.example/482

sam: ack. can you paste the first failing log line?

anya: sure, here's the earliest error from the step that hits the toolcall:

anya: ```
2026-03-17T14:12:01.234Z ERROR toolcall auth failure status=401 body={"error":"invalid_token","message":"kid not found"} request_id=rpc-9a7f
2026-03-17T14:12:01.235Z WARN auth jwks cache miss for issuer=https://auth-hosted.redwood/ keys_url=/jwks.json
```

matt: "kid not found" screams JWKS/key rotation. did anyone rotate signing keys overnight?

nora: there was a scheduled key rotation yesterday at ~01:00 UTC for hosted-auth (ops ticket #556). no infra PR touching auth-proxy in the last 24h though.

sam: can we reproduce quickly from a dev box with a known-bad token? try a raw streaming call.

anya: repro attempt (sanitized):

anya: ```bash
TOKEN="ey...badkid..."
curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://hosted.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-small"
# response:
# HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
# WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="kid not found"
```

matt: ok — likely JWKS cache lingered with old keys and the new token references a rotated kid. infra-bot, can you check jwks fetch logs / TTLs for the auth-proxy in us-west-2 staging? @nora can do restart if needed.

infra-bot: logs show jwks fetch failure at 2026-03-17T14:11:59Z: upstream returned 503 intermittently; cached keys expired at 14:11:30Z; fetch retried but 503 for ~30s, then succeeded at 14:12:40Z. TTL configured: 5m.

nora: thanks — I'm going to flush jwks cache on staging auth-proxy and restart the instance to clear any stale in-memory caches. pinging oncall.

nora: @oncall restarting auth-proxy-staging-1 now

ci-bot: rerun queued: shard=19 requested_by=anya

nora: auth-proxy-staging-1 restart initiated (staging-usw2)

system: auth-proxy-staging-1 down -> up (restart completed)

nora: jwks cache flush done, verified fetch now returns new key set with kid=abcd1234 at 2026-03-17T14:14:02Z

ci-bot: rerun started: shard=19 user=anya

ci-bot: rerun finished: shard=19 — ALL TESTS PASSED (6/6)

anya: rerun green, nice. but CI later shows shard-21 failing with a different error (streaming 422 multipart boundary).

sam: different failure, likely unrelated. can we close this JWKS flake?

matt: capture for postmortem — root cause: key rotation + transient jwks upstream 503 -> cache expiry window. remediation ideas: extend jwks TTL to 10m, add alert on jwks-fetch-503 rate > 5/min, and make proxy fallback to last-known-keys for a short window. created infra ticket RED-789 for followups.

nora: noted. I'll add a short-term monitor and follow RED-789.

anya: thanks everyone. will spin up a separate thread for the multipart/422 shard-21 failures so we don't mix things. closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
